meta.title: Laurel en Lienzo | Custom illustrations and creative workshops
meta.description: Catalog of custom illustrations, T-shirts and creative workshops. Exclusive handmade pieces to connect with you.

hero.title: <highlight>CREATE</highlight> FEEL CONNECT
hero.subtitle: Personalizable illustrations crafted down to the smallest detail so you can be part of them, adding colour or details. Creative workshops and exclusive pieces to take with you.

cookie.title: We use cookies
cookie.intro: We use technical cookies so the website works and Google Analytics cookies to understand how many people visit it. You can accept, reject or configure them.
cookie.requiredDescription: They are needed for the website to work: they store your language and the personalised products. They do not require consent.
cookie.analyticsDescription: Third-party cookies managed by Google Ireland Limited that measure visitor numbers in aggregate form. They are only installed if you accept them and you can turn them off at any time.
